Use when the user wants to run an approved prompt through the CLI to generate an image; mentions "dreamina", "即梦CLI", "命令行生图", "生成图片"; asks to run, submit, or execute a prompt; or needs credit checking, task status querying, session management, or result downloading. This skill covers installation verification, authentication, parameter mapping from prompt specifications, 4 standard execution workflows, and 6 error handling patterns from official documentation. Always use this skill when the user wants to generate images via the dreamina command line.
